Hm, that's not a build time validation error but a runtime problem. That's weird as we have tests for this. Would you care to create a simple reproducer app?

I get the same kind of error for the `format` method, but only after a few reloads:
```io.quarkus.qute.TemplateException: Rendering error in template [modules/Footer.qute.html] line 38: Method "format('Y')" not found on the base object "java.time.LocalDateTime" in expression {footer.date.format('Y')}```

Initially this works a few reloads until it suddenly stops working and won't work again until I restart the Quarkus app. It always works the first time I load the site after starting Quarkus.

From what I can see it stops working after the message `Live reload total time`, for the other reloads I see `Files changed but restart not needed`, so maybe live reload related.

Maybe these are related.

> Hm, that's not a build time validation error but a runtime problem. That's weird as we have tests for this. Would you care to create a simple reproducer app?

It is strange but this error appears after live reload as @rasmushaglund said. On the first start of the application it works fine. After first live reload it crashes with this error. [Here](https://github.com/Bazalii/Job-search-system/tree/9-connect-backend-with-frontend) is a reproducer. To get the error you should clone the repo, checkout the branch 9-connect-backend-with-frontend, start the application, after that please comment line 152 in HtmlPagesController.kt to trigger live reload and to see the page without authentication and then if you go to http://localhost:8080/pages/resumes?pageIndex=0&pageSize=5 you will get that error.

> start the application

How do you start the app?

When I do `./gradlew build` in the root dir I get `java.util.NoSuchElementException: SRCFG00011: Could not expand value platform.quarkus.native.builder-image in property quarkus.native.builder-image`. When I try to build modules separately then I get `UnsatisfiedResolutionException: Unsatisfied dependency for type programmingLanguages.repositories.IProgrammingLanguageRepository` for `./gradlew core:build`. 

When I run the `web` module in the dev mode I can see the login page but commenting `@RolesAllowed("User", "HR", "Admin")` does not seem to have any effect, i.e. I can't get to the `/pages/resumes`.

By the way, I have noticed that your're using RESTEasy classic. You should switch to RESTEasy Reactive which is the preferred JAX-RS implementation for a long time (https://quarkus.io/blog/resteasy-reactive/).

>How do you start the app?

Sorry for not mentioning the command to start. I use `./gradlew web:build` or `./gradlew web:quarkusDev`. 

> I can't get to the /pages/resumes

Yes, it is not possible to open `/pages/resumes` because it is a page with pagination and requires query params, please try `/pages/resumes?pageIndex=0&pageSize=5`

>By the way, I have noticed that your're using RESTEasy classic. You should switch to RESTEasy Reactive which is the preferred 
JAX-RS implementation for a long time

I use classic resteasy because I faced another issue with qute-reactive. 

The idea behind resteasy-reactive is that if the signature of the method is synchronous (without using Uni, Multi, etc.) this method will be called in worker thread as expected for a synchronous method. I have only synchronous methods in my project that worked fine with resteasy-reactive. But when I added usage of qute-reactive I faced this error without making any of the methods async:

issue.title: Qute - fix a regression introduced in #32653 (3.0.1)
issue.body:
- value resolvers are not registered for non-application classes after hot reload
- fixes #32959
